caption:
# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface

## Window Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Left: "Activities" label
  - Center: "LibreOffice Writer" application name
  - Right: System time "Oct 22 19:44" and system tray icons (including sound and power)

## Desktop Environment Sidebar

- **Left Vertical Dock**
  - Application icons from top to bottom:
    - Google Chrome
    - Thunderbird Mail
    - Visual Studio Code
    - VLC Media Player
    - LibreOffice Writer (currently active)
    - LibreOffice Calc
    - LibreOffice Impress
    - GIMP
    - File Manager
    - Software Center
    - Help (Question Mark)
    - Trash
  - Bottom: Grid icon for application launcher

## LibreOffice Writer Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## Toolbar

- **Quick Access Toolbar**
  - Icons for: New Document, Open, Save, Print, Undo, Redo, Find, Spelling, and more

- **Formatting Toolbar**
  - **Paragraph Style Dropdown**: "Default Paragraph Style"
  - **Font Selection**: "Calibri" with dropdown arrow
  - **Font Size**: "11 pt" with dropdown arrow
  - **Text Formatting Buttons**: Bold (B), Italic (I), Underline (U), Strikethrough (S)
  - **Font Effects**: Superscript (A°), Subscript (Aₐ), Font Color, Highlight Color
  - **Alignment**: Left, Center, Right, Justify
  - **List Styles**: Bulleted List, Numbered List
  - **Paragraph Indentation**: Increase/Decrease Indent
  - **Text Direction**: Left-to-Right, Right-to-Left

## Status Bar

- **Document Information**
  - "Page 1 of 1"
  - "23 words, 190 characters"
  - "Default Page Style"
  - "English (USA)"
  - Zoom level: "60%"

## Document Content Area

- **Document Title**: "Ophthalmologist_Prescription.docx"
- **Document Layout**
  - **Header Section**
    - Text: "Latanoprost eye drops"
    - Boxed area for "Doctor's Name" with "Specialist in" below
    - Caduceus medical symbol to the right
  - **Patient Information Fields**
    - "Name: [blank line]"
    - "Age: [blank line]"
    - "Gender: [blank line]"
    - "Date: [blank line]"
  - **Prescription Area**
    - Large blank rectangular area for prescription details
  - **Signature Line**
    - "Signature: [blank line]" with red arrow pointing right
  - **Hospital Information Box**
    - "Hospital Name"
    - "Address"
    - "Line, Street Name,"
    - "Country, Pin Code."

## Sidebar Panels

- **Right Vertical Sidebar**
  - **Panel Toggle Button**: Three horizontal lines
  - **Icons from top to bottom**:
    - Document properties
    - Styles
    - Navigator
    - Comments
    - Object properties
    - Font settings

## Notification Bar

- **Blue Information Bar**
  - Left: Two blue circular icons with "i" symbol
  - Text: "Help us make LibreOffice better" and "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - Right: "Get involved" button and "Donate" button
  - Close button (X) on the right side of the notification bar

## Font Warning Tooltip

- **Tooltip Displayed**
  - Triggered by hovering over font name field
  - Text: "Font Name. The current font is not available and will be substituted."
